verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer intent-classification-2 reference, this board offers stronger tinted regional grouping and richer semantic color, but its denser routing, obstructed labels, and long perimeter runs make the flow less immediately readable.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The four lifecycle regions fill the frame effectively with balanced top and bottom masses, though the narrow inter-region routing bands feel congested.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Failure: several chips and edge labels lack clear air—examples include the crowded callback/state labels near External OAuth provider and partially obscured text along the top and lower flows.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Four clearly titled, differently tinted regions provide strong lifecycle grouping, with the token-use and audit clusters visibly distinct.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Blue, green, purple, orange, and red are used consistently enough to distinguish flow families and security outcomes, including dashed orange failure/audit paths.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Failure: there are no crosshair junctions, but a few arrowheads terminate awkwardly at region or node boundaries and some labels appear detached from or layered across their routes.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The primary rows and section headers hold useful registers, but the bottom clusters vary in density and vertical alignment enough to feel busier and less polished than the upper rows.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Failure: multiple purple, green, and dashed orange paths make long perimeter detours between regions, while several runs pass behind labels or hug section boundaries, slowing traceability.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The visual ordering and assigned scores agree: gc-decomp-harness ranks first at 7.5, intent-classification-2 second at 7.0, and the board under grade third at 6.5.
